# Reducto API Documentation

> > Reducto API enables document processing, parsing, extraction, and editing for PDFs, DOCX, spreadsheets, and forms using Python, JavaScript, and Go SDKs.

Reducto provides enterprise-ready document intelligence APIs with OCR, table extraction, form filling, and multi-document pipeline capabilities. The platform includes Reducto Studio for visual pipeline configuration, CLI tools, and supports async processing with webhook integrations.

## Key Topics

- Reducto API
- Document parsing and extraction
- PDF and DOCX processing
- Form filling and editing
- Python SDK
- JavaScript SDK
- Reducto Studio
- Pipeline configuration
- Batch processing
- Table extraction
- OCR and chunking
- Document sections and splitting
- Enterprise deployment (SOC 2, AWS/GCP/Azure)
- Webhook and async operations
- Identity verification and KYC

## Getting Started & Core Concepts

- [Enterprise Readiness](https://docs.reducto.ai/enterprise/enterprise-readiness): Enterprise security, SOC 2, SLA, and deployment options (AWS/GCP/Azure)
- [Reducto CLI](https://docs.reducto.ai/cli): CLI tool for parsing, extracting, and editing documents from command line

## Studio Pipelines

- [Split Pipeline](https://docs.reducto.ai/studio-split): Studio Split pipeline for dividing documents into targeted sections
- [Edit Pipeline](https://docs.reducto.ai/studio-edit): Studio Edit pipeline for form filling with natural language instructions

## Workflows & Use Cases

- [Multi-document Pipelines](https://docs.reducto.ai/workflows/multi-document-pipelines): Process multiple related documents with shared extraction context
- [Parallel Document Processing](https://docs.reducto.ai/cookbooks/batch-processing): AsyncReducto cookbook for concurrent processing with progress tracking
- [ID & Onboarding Documents](https://docs.reducto.ai/cookbooks/identity-verification): KYC identity verification cookbook using ID cards, utility bills, W-9 forms
- [Spreadsheet Processing](https://docs.reducto.ai/configs/parse/spreadsheet): Configure Excel/CSV spreadsheet parsing, clustering, and table splitting

## Python SDK Reference

- [Edit](https://docs.reducto.ai/sdk/python/edit): Python SDK edit method for PDF form filling and DOCX modification

## JavaScript SDK Reference

- [Pipeline](https://docs.reducto.ai/sdk/javascript/pipeline): JavaScript SDK pipeline method combining parse and extract operations
- [Upload](https://docs.reducto.ai/sdk/javascript/upload): JavaScript SDK upload method for documents, S3, and large file streaming
- [Edit](https://docs.reducto.ai/sdk/javascript/edit): JavaScript SDK edit method for PDF/DOCX form filling and modification
- [Split](https://docs.reducto.ai/sdk/javascript/split): JavaScript SDK split method for document section partitioning

## REST API Reference

- [Upload](https://docs.reducto.ai/api-reference/upload): REST API upload endpoint with multipart form data support
- [Edit Async](https://docs.reducto.ai/api-reference/edit-async): Async edit endpoint with webhook support for document modification
- [Go SDK Pipeline](https://docs.reducto.ai/sdk/go/pipeline): Go SDK pipeline workaround using direct REST API calls

## Optional

- [Legacy: Get Version](https://docs.reducto.ai/api-reference/legacy/get-version): Legacy API endpoint for version checking
- [Legacy: Edit](https://docs.reducto.ai/api-reference/legacy/edit): Legacy API edit endpoint for document modification
- [Legacy: Parse](https://docs.reducto.ai/api-reference/legacy/parse): Legacy API parse endpoint for OCR, chunking, and table extraction
